name: loading4_a
prompt: Loading screen illustration for a mobile game about a gang of street cats living in a back-alley hideout. Portrait 2:3. Gritty comic-book style (thick ink outlines, warm dusk light, halftone texture). COMPOSITION exactly like the FIRST reference: the three cats as one TIGHT GROUP in the CENTRE of the picture, close together, shoulders touching and overlapping a little, on one pile of trash bags and crates in the middle, a gang portrait; the alley walls at the sides, city rooftops at sunset behind. Do NOT copy the cats of the FIRST reference: their LOOKS and BODY PROPORTIONS come from the SECOND reference (their true relative sizes) and the THIRD, FOURTH and FIFTH references (each cat alone): the same colours, markings, head-to-body proportions and builds - Ponchik is very fat and round with a small head and is the biggest, Shnyr is thin with big ears. Give each cat a lively pose of his own (not the reference poses, no arms folded): Ryzhy (orange tabby, cocky grin) in the middle, a little higher, the barbell made of a stick and two bundles of tin cans resting on his shoulder; Shnyr on the left leaning on Ryzhy, sly smile, flipping a bottle cap; Ponchik on the right sitting heavily on the trash bags, munching a fish skeleton, grumpy. Leave the TOP third of the picture as sky (a logo goes there) and the BOTTOM sixth as darker ground (a loading bar goes there). No text, no letters, no logo.
